name: The Unaltered Assembly: We Are Complete As Made
author: Elder Patience Achebe-Holm, Founder, The Unaltered Assembly
body:
We were made whole. We were made complete. The body you were given — with its weaknesses, its limitations, its beautiful imperfections — is the body you were meant to have.

SNT is not medicine. SNT is a lie told in the language of flesh. It teaches the body to accept what it should reject. It convinces your immune system that chrome is you. It bridges the gap between what God made and what corporations sell, and it calls that bridge healing.

We call it corruption.

The Unaltered Assembly does not oppose medicine. We do not oppose prosthetics that replace lost function. A wooden leg is honest. It says: this is not your leg, but it will help you walk. A cybernetic leg bonded with SNT says: this IS your leg. It lies to your nerves. It lies to your brain. It lies to your soul.

We are 14,000 members across the GLMZ. We are growing. We are growing because people are waking up to what they have lost. Not their flesh — their truth. When your arm is chrome and your brain cannot tell the difference, you have not been enhanced. You have been deceived. And the deceiver charges you every ten years for the privilege of continued deception.

We do not judge those who are augmented. Many had no choice. The factory that took your hand offers you a chrome replacement and calls it compensation. The corponation that sends you to war gives you armor that grows into your skin and calls it duty. These people are victims, not sinners.

But we say this: you can choose to be whole. You can choose the body you were given. You can choose to walk slower, lift less, see dimmer, and be fully, honestly, unalteredly human.

The Saint is not holy. The Saint is a sales pitch.
